summary: Converted every hardcoded gate-count assertion in test-gate-registry-resolution.sh and test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh (plus the crash-net suite and measure-gate-costs.sh) to derive from the live gate registry via a new gate_registry_max_id accessor. Added two cross-source drift guards (G1, G2) and a permanent throwaway-gate fixture proof in both suites via a new gate_store_fixture_build library. Directly fixed a real regression that materialized mid-dispatch (a sibling task registered a real gate 27, which made one assertion go genuinely red) and confirmed the fix in the final covering run. Redeployed via deploy-headless.sh; the deploy landed successfully with all 9 declared file_scope files confirmed byte-identical, but the full-battery check carries two documented, confirmed-unrelated exclusions.
